rows.name: Breakdown of the average residential tax bill, fiscal 1996
rows.printed_heading: Lunenburg Board of Assessors / Breakdown of the Average Residential Tax Bill / Fiscal Year 1996 / Town Service or Budget Category | Budgeted Amount | Percent of Tax Levy | Cost to Average Taxpayer
rows.what_it_is: NEW DATASET. The Assessors' allocation of the FY1996 budget over the average residential bill: budgeted amount, share of the levy, dollars per average taxpayer. Category rows (Town Administrative, Public Safety, ...) print the subtotal of the lines under them. The percent and cost columns are the Assessors' arithmetic, not a record. TOTAL COST OF TOWN SERVICES 11,369,011 on p48 equals the TOTAL BUDGET VOTED under Article 5 (p77) checks=none: the validator reads the category rows as items and sums them with their own lines (rows sum about twice the total), so it called every row `check failed` on figures that tie. BY HAND every category equals the sum of its lines (Town Administrative 533,602 ... Debt Retirement 309,788) and the eight categories sum to 11,369,011, the printed TOTAL; the percent column sums to 99.9999. Rows are therefore `no check` until a subtotal-above-its-block rule exists (NEEDS.md); `no total printed` in their reconciliation is the reader's wording, not the page

What the data shows: the printed total includes funds whose net is that quadruple and that are not listed on pp57-59 (the lines file holds no such figures). It does not show which funds, or whether the total or the list is the printed error. The p57 heading row is not lost: the lines on pp57-59 match the cells row for row
